pinned_sources.conventions_checked: HFT printed1 standing positive integern>1; printed5 normalized rotation-invariant surface probability; printed12 formulas1.15/1.16; printed15 theorem1.21.

objects.original: A uniform vector ζ in the real Euclidean unit sphere S^(n−1), U=ζ₁, and normalized surface measure σ.
objects.reconstructed: E=EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), coordinate0, τ=volume.toSphere on the sphere subtype, and σ=(τ univ)⁻¹ • map inclusion τ.
objects.evidence: The carrier is the standard l2 Euclidean space. Coordinate0 is the source first coordinate under zero-based indexing. Mathlib HaarToSphere.lean:49–110 constructs the actual cone/surface law with finite nonzero mass in nontrivial finite-dimensional E. SphericalPoisson.lean:160–166 normalizes τ to a probability; :298–308 identifies σ as its measurable-inclusion pushforward. SphereHaar.column_map_eq_normalized_surface identifies this exact ambient law with an actual full-orthogonal Haar column, and proves probability, sphere support and orthogonal invariance internally.

domains.original: Raw v1 literally gives both n≥2 and the later clause where n≥3. The unambiguous source intersection is n≥3. The radial parameter satisfies strict0<r<1.
domains.reconstructed: All n∈ℕ with2≤n and all r∈ℝ with0<r<1; normalized measure supported on the Euclidean unit sphere.
domains.evidence: The n=2 case is an explicit extension beyond the unambiguous source intersection, consistently disclosed in module documentation, lesson assumptions and publication assumption_deltas. It is actually proved by the logarithmic branch potential_data:78–98. The focused selected consumer retains3≤n and4≤κ. The theorem includes neither r endpoint. Acceptance of source fidelity is for n≥3; n=2 is separately accepted ASTIS mathematics, not a correction to raw v1.

quantifiers.original: For each allowed dimension, every0<r<1 has both stated expectations for a uniform vector and its first coordinate.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Implicit universal n with proof2≤n; universal r with proofs0<r and r<1; j0, τ, σ and K are determined let-bound objects; all four conclusions hold jointly.
quantifiers.evidence: The actual public signature at SphericalPoisson.lean:272–288 has no scoped variables, hidden analytic hypotheses, existential law choice or separately assumed moment values. set_option autoImplicit false is active. The added dimension2 range is recorded in the domains slot, rather than treated as a source quantifier correction.

assumptions.original: The source requires a uniform sphere law, its dimension restriction and0<r<1. Positivity, finiteness, continuity and harmonicity used to prove these particular moments are proof ingredients.
assumptions.reconstructed: Only2≤n,0<r andr<1 are public hypotheses; the literal law, support, denominator positivity, normalized mass and L1 facts are derived.
assumptions.evidence: SphericalPoisson.lean:160–192 obtains nontriviality, τ≠0, normalized probability, D>0, K>0, continuity and genuine L1 internally. :202–207 and :223–237 discharge harmonic-neighborhood and gradient-transfer inputs internally. No producer conclusion has been moved into the public binder list. Dimension2 is disclosed separately.

conclusion.original: E[D^(−n/2)]=1/(1−r²) andE[U D^(−n/2)]=r/(1−r²), with finite expectations, D=1+r²−2rU.
conclusion.reconstructed: Both actual Bochner Integrable facts and the corresponding real integrals of1/D^(n/2) andU/D^(n/2), with the same right-hand sides.
conclusion.evidence: On the sphere, D=‖rζ−e‖²>0 by sphere_geometry and hD. Real.rpow_neg at positive D identifiesD^(−n/2) with(D^(n/2))⁻¹. The ambient pushforward has no off-sphere mass, so totalized off-support rpow/division values do not change the integrals. :190–193 proves both L1 facts before integral_sub is used; :194–222 proves the unweighted value; :238–266 proves the weighted value; :298–308 transports both L1 facts and values. 1−r²>0 is proved internally at:218.

scopes.original: A1 is the two-moment identity, obtained by applying HFT1.21 to1 andx₁; B.2.2 uses the selected numerator immediately before Eq24. HFT1.21 applies to functions continuous on the closed unit ball and harmonic on the open ball.
scopes.reconstructed: The public result is exactly the two moment/L1 facts. The implementation uses a separately attributed direct mean-value/zero-flux argument. The focused test evaluates the actual selected numerator; it does not evaluate the signed Gaussian expectation or prove Eq24.
scopes.evidence: The HFT printed15/PDF23 render shows the closed-ball bar in the continuity hypothesis. Module introduction, lesson reader_note/source attributions and publication scope preserve the author/general-representation route separately. Test:11–64 proves the source selected numerator undern≥3,κ≥4 from the two moments and SelectedTilt.selected_tilt. Neither endpoint is included. Fresh packet2 corrects the prose consumer reference to the actual global selected_numerator_value in the named test file; the independent corrected Lean #check probe passes.

constant_dependencies.original: The moment values depend only on r and n throughD; the pre-Eq24 selected numerator depends onκ,n via s=√κ and selectedr. No unspecified constants appear.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Exactly1/(1−r²),r/(1−r²); internal potential coefficientc₂=1,c_n=2−n otherwise; selected numerator−(s−1)/(n(1−r²)).
constant_dependencies.evidence: potentialCoefficient_ne_zero:139–143 justifies cancellation, includingn=2. Test:49–63 proves(s+1)r−(s−1)=−(s−1)/n withn≠0 ands+1≠0 derived internally. No regularity constant, domination bound, probability normalization constant or hiddenκ condition is added to the public moment theorem.

private_helpers.name: sphere_geometry
private_helpers.evidence: Actual unit-vector norm, squared-distance denominator, and radial inner-product identities.

private_helpers.name: pole_excluded
private_helpers.evidence: A unit pole is excluded from every closed ball centered0 with radius<1, including vacuous negative-radius cases.

private_helpers.name: potentialProfile
private_helpers.evidence: Literal½log squared distance forn=2; power1−n/2 otherwise, used away from pole.

private_helpers.name: potential
private_helpers.evidence: Literal shifted squared-distance composition; totalized off-pole semantics do not introduce a characterized fallback.

private_helpers.name: potentialCoefficient
private_helpers.evidence: Actual derivative coefficient1 atn=2 and2−n otherwise.

private_helpers.name: potential_data
private_helpers.evidence: Positive squared distance yields actual C2. The radial rule, explicit log/inverse and rpow first/second derivative calculations prove gradient and zero Laplacian in both branches.

private_helpers.name: potential_harmonic
private_helpers.evidence: C2 at each point plus zero Laplacian on the open pole complement gives HarmonicOnNhd; this is neighborhood harmonicity, not just pointwise cancellation.

private_helpers.name: potentialCoefficient_ne_zero
private_helpers.evidence: Separate n=2 case and natural-to-real cast inequality prove cancellation is legal.

private_helpers.name: subtype_moments
private_helpers.evidence: Derives nonzero finite normalized law, positivity and genuine L1. Harmonic Poisson-kernel mean value gives the first value. R=(1+r)/2 strictly contains the observation sphere before EventuallyEq.gradient_eq transfers gradients. Actual zero flux then yields weighted value using L1 linearity and nonzero coefficient.
